notes: Summary: Lynchpin builds compliance automation for mid/large banks; looking to replace on-prem inference infra with Redwood Private (VPC) for lower ops burden and standardized audits.
Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS/HSM integration, end-to-end audit logs, and explicit data residency to US-East (and Canada for certain clients).
Security team emphasis: must map Redwood controls to Lynchpin SOC 2 / ISO 27001 control matrix; need evidence (architecture diagram, control owners, test results).

HIPAA/BAA: not core product currently, but they have a healthcare vertical pilot — legal asked for BAA language and proof of handling PHI; they want encryption-in-transit & at-rest plus KMS separation for PHI keys.

PCI considerations: they tokenize card data upstream but want confirmation that Redwood Private components will not be in PCI CDE; need guidance on scoping and audit artifacts (segmentation evidence, logs retention policy).
KMS: preference for Cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (BYOK option). They asked about key lifecycle, rotation, and ability to rotate without redeploying model artifacts.

Audit logging: need immutable audit trail for inference requests, admin config changes, and key access events; retention 7 years for financial records (we discussed sticky retention + long-term archive).
Latency/throughput targets: 99th pct latency < 150ms for chat-like workflows; peak throughput 400 qps for batch reranking; cost sensitivity moderate given compliance overhead.
Model preferences: open models fine (quantized variants), but must support pinned model versions and deterministic rollback for rollouts; fallback rules required during maintenance windows.
Quote from security lead (Mar 5): "We need a mapping of Redwood controls to our internal SOX/SOC matrix — without that we can't move forward with the pilot."
POC notes: Completed small POC in Redwood Private VPC (staging). Demonstrated KMS envelope encryption, but customer requested proof of HSM-backed KMS (simulated in POC).
Commercial: Procurement will push for hybrid contract: committed Dedicated capacity for 12 months + Private deployment uplift; preliminary ARR target discussed ~ $700k/year.
Next internal ask: Prepare Compliance Mapping Spreadsheet (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / PCI) and deliver to their security team by 2026-03-20.
Short threads: Legal is leaning conservative — wants explicit audit log export path and a legal-reviewed BAA template before exec sign-off.
